profile.headline: Software Engineer Mobile, iOS at CBS Interactive
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and delivering high-quality mobile applications, with a strong background in iOS development, automated testing, and cross-functional collaboration. Served as a Temporary Lead Software Engineer, guiding technical decisions, coordinating with QA and Product, and driving teams to meet all quarterly goals during a leadership transition. Known for ownership, clear communication, and reliable execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute to the design, development, and delivery of high-quality software while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners, including QA and Product.
Support team delivery through clear communication, ownership, and consistent execution.

positions.title: Temp Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Stepped into a temporary Lead Engineer role to support technical leadership, guide design decisions, and mentor engineers. Collaborated closely with QA and Product to drive on-time delivery, successfully achieving all quarterly goals and supporting team success during a leadership transition.

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Automated Apple TV end to end testing using Swift.
Performed backend endpoint testing, manual media testing, and camera feed testing.
Improved iOS automation test suite by fixing failed test cases, improving test execution time, and refactoring.
Reduced the time it took to run tests by 50%, by improving the test cases, removing unnecessary sleep, and disabling animations in the app for debug mode.
Wrote unit tests to achieve and maintain 100% test coverage.
Assisted iOS team by fixing iOS bugs.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Programmatically implemented iOS UI designs using SnapKit
• Developed a share card in Android where users could share via FB, Twitter, mail, and/or text
• Implemented Android UI designs

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
•	Devised a workaround to test a UISearchBar view by using the built-in clipboard.
•	Utilized the SD card to expedite the setup/teardown flow for tests involving 3rd party apps.
•	Wrote a function to scroll through a feed and locate specific posts.
•	Assisted development teams in efficient test plan formulation and provided engineering teams with technical support and guidance.
•	Wrote and maintained automated test suites and infrastructure.
•	Thoroughly investigated failures to determine root cause of issues.
•	Performed validation and verification testing on resolved issues.
•	Proactively improved test coverage and quality control efficiency.

positions.title: Web Production
positions.description: •	Worked on a team to create a new corporate website using the Hybris Web Content Management System.

positions.title: Website Development
positions.description:
•	Developed website mockups for clients to ensure quality control and client satisfaction before project development phase.
•	Installed and customized Wordpress and set CSS themes for client design.
•	Developed and maintained front end functionality of websites and ensured their UX and usability.
•	Website development includes: Wordpress, CSS, HTML, Photoshop CS6, and SQL.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: • Taking ownership for enhancing the customer experience, assisting customers by utilizing approved consultative selling practices and guidelines to identify customer needs and provide appropriate solutions

positions.title: Reader (Grader)
positions.description: •	Graded assignments for: Discrete Math, Introduction to System Programming, Assembly Language, and Compiler Design.

projects.title: MovieTime App
projects.description:
This app is hitting the OMDB server API to get a list of movies to display in a tableView using SwiftUI.
- Created a tableView to display a list of movies.
- Users are able to search by movies and results will be displayed accordingly.

projects.title: Judgement-Game App
projects.description: Judgment is a game where you have to predict the number of hands you'll make and try to make those number of hands that you predict. It is a WIP where the game logic is complete, but more work needs to done for UI and refactor code.
